name: Bernauerhof
beschreibung: The Hotel Bernauerhof is an accommodation establishment in the federal state of Tirol. It offers guests various room categories with private bathrooms and some with balconies. The hotel’s facilities include a restaurant serving regional cuisine and a wellness area with sauna. The hotel is suitable for holidaymakers and business travelers. The surrounding area offers activities such as hiking and skiing. The hotel is run as a family business. Parking is available at the hotel.
